rationale: Build on the best reverse recurrent-tail baseline with a minimal structural transplant: keep the proven decoder-output anchor, but let each recurrent tail block learn a small rolling-anchor interpolation via new `tail_anchor_mix` control tensors. This targets the underexplored recurrence-scheduling/carry path without changing eval, data flow, wallclock behavior, or export, and keeps the new tensors in the float-preserved control set.
title: Reverse Tail Anchor Mix
